### vectordotdev/vector (timberio/vector)

### [`v0.59.0`](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/vector/releases/tag/v0.59.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/vectordotdev/vector/compare/v0.58.0...v0.59.0)

The [COSE team](https://opensource.datadoghq.com/about/#the-community-open-source-engineering-team) is happy to announce Vector `0.59.0`! 🚀 Vector is a lightweight, ultra-fast tool for building observability pipelines that puts you in control of your data.

Thanks to the 21 contributors who made the 41 changes in this release!

- [6 breaking changes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.59.0/#breaking-changes)
- [2 security changes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.59.0/#security-changes)
- [3 new features](https://vector.dev/releases/0.59.0/#new-features)
- [10 enhancements](https://vector.dev/releases/0.59.0/#enhancements)
- [20 bug fixes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.59.0/#bug-fixes)

Upgrading to 0.59? Read the [upgrade guide](https://vector.dev/highlights/2026-10-05-0-59-0-upgrade-guide/).

[View the full release notes](https://vector.dev/releases/0.59.0/) · See upcoming releases on the [release calendar](https://calendar.vector.dev).
